newsitem.title: USA: TCI nixes spin-off of Liberty and others.
newsitem.headline: TCI nixes spin-off of Liberty and others.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc said Wednesday it will not spin off Liberty Media Corp and two other subsidiaries because the Internal Revenue Service has refused to rule on its request for tax-free spinoffs.

The company's decision to spin off Liberty Media, Tele-Communications International Inc and Southern Satellite Systems Inc depended in part upon a favorable ruling allowing the transactions to be tax-free to its shareholders.
The company said it may consider refiling any or all of the ruling requests.
TCI said the IRS decision came after it was unable to meet the agency's request concerning the potential disposal of TCI stock by the estate of its founder, Bob Magness.

The agency wanted assurance from the estate that it would not dispose of TCI stock or stock of the spun-off corporations, or that if it did so, it would sell the shares in proportionately equal amounts, TCI said.
TCI said that the estate was unable to make such assurances because of fiduciary duties to beneficiaries.
"Each of these assets is extremely valuable and TCI's stockholders will now continue to share in those values through their TCI Group and Liberty Media Group holdings, TCI said in a release.
TCI is the nation's largest cable television operator. The company's shares closed Wednesday off 1/4 at 11-3/8.
